messages:
Nadia (product): Quick spike outcome: several pilot customers asked for explicit retention and export guarantees for SOC2. Need a concise launch checklist that teams can agree on.
Ethan (eng-runtime): From the spike, we can commit to: a) per-tenant retention config, b) signed export bundles (AsymmetricSign), c) legal-hold flag. The hard bit is full 7y indexed search. Recommend tiers.
Priya (security): Also need to define key rotation/escrow policy. Options: tenant-provided public key, tenant-managed KMS integration (we call AsymmetricSign), or escrow (third-party). For verification over time, manifest must include key_version and signature algorithm.
Carlos (ops): Operational constraints: we'll limit concurrent exports and offer a "fast lane" add-on for critical audits. Cost estimates: hot indexed storage 0.02-0.03 $/GB/mo; cold archive 0.0008-0.0012.
legal-bot: Legal: require SLA language and a limited warranty for exported evidence (30 day availability). Also suggest retention exceptions flow. Tagging legal.
Nadia (product): Proposed Launch Checklist for Pilot: 1) Signed export manifest (verifiable by tenant); 2) Retention lanes (hot 90d, warm 2y, cold 7y archival); 3) BYOK rotation support with preserved verification; 4) Legal-hold toggle and purge protection; 5) Export audit events and proof-of-delivery.
Ethan (eng-runtime): Dev estimates: 2 sprints for signing+manifest+basic export plumbing, 1 sprint for retention gates and legal-hold.
Priya (security): I'll draft the rotation policy and include threat model and verification steps.
Carlos (ops): I'll produce a short pricing appendix and required ops runbook.
Nadia (product): I'll assemble PRD and invite stakeholders. Action owners: Ethan (manifest prototype), Priya (rotation doc), Carlos (cost/runbook), legal (SLA).
